description: An eight-channel mixer with a level, a pan and a mute on every channel, voltage control of level and pan, an output for each channel and a stereo mix

params.text: Sets the level of the stereo mix, 0 to 1, starting at 0 so the mix is silent until this is raised
Sets the level of that channel, 0 to 1, starting at 0 so the channel is silent until this is raised
Places that channel in the stereo picture, -1 at the left and +1 at the right, on a sine and cosine law that holds the power constant across the sweep
Each press toggles that channel between audible and silent, and the lamp is lit while the channel is silenced

inputs.text: Scales the stereo mix on top of the MIX LEVEL knob: 0V silences the mix, 10V leaves it at the knob setting, and voltages beyond that range are clamped
The signal fed into that channel of the mixer
Scales that channel on top of its LEVEL knob: 0V silences the channel, 10V leaves it at the knob setting, and voltages beyond that range are clamped
Multiplies the left and right gains set by that channel's PAN knob, moving the channel across the stereo picture; at exactly 0V the knob alone applies

outputs.text: The left half of the stereo mix, carrying all eight channels after their pans, the MIX LEVEL knob and MIX CV IN
The right half of the stereo mix, carrying all eight channels after their pans, the MIX LEVEL knob and MIX CV IN
That channel on its own, after its LEVEL knob, its LEVEL CV IN and its MUTE, with the left and right halves of the pan added back together so PAN alters its level

notes: every channel LEVEL and MIX LEVEL come up at 0, so a freshly placed mixer passes nothing; raise the channel level and the mix level before anything reaches OUT L and OUT R
